objective: Style the feed's stream template, the PostNode card and thread, the LiveScoreTickerDecorator score block and the like control, as wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/layout.md sections 3-4 and components.md section 4 specify.
acceptance_criteria: A top-level PostNode renders as Card with as="article"; a nested reply is an <article> without the card class.

LiveScoreTickerDecorator still renders its children first and unchanged, keeps role="status" named Live score, and renders one GameScore per live_scores entry, with a Live badge for status Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, OT, BT or HT and no Live badge for an unknown status.
While the feed loads, a StatusLine with the existing text and three aria-hidden skeletons render; a failed load renders InlineAlert; an empty feed renders EmptyState with the existing text.
An expanded post whose thread has zero replies shows the text No replies yet.
The like button carries data-active when the post is liked and not otherwise; the text N likes remains a single text node.
Show replies contains an aria-hidden chevron icon and its aria-expanded behaviour is unchanged.
Load more renders through Button with variant secondary, keeps its name, and is still absent once the feed has no further page.

Every *.module.css file this unit adds contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).
feed-isolation.test.ts and every existing feed test pass unchanged.
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
